data_manifest.layout: rows of 2049 token ids; x=row[:-1], y=row[1:]

tokenizer.tokenizer: native RustBPE 32768 vocab, first 100M capped characters from training shard
tokenizer.benchmark: native base_train d8/D512/2K/SSSL, 300 steps x 32768 model tokens; original source unmodified
tokenizer.purpose: Throughput pilot tokenizer; native RustBPE; train shard only

data_manifest.epoch_note: Native loader cycles the entire 13-shard training split. Epoch tracks source reads into the document buffer, not exact consumed unique tokens.
data_manifest.validation: dev first 64 rows, test next 1024 rows; no shared packed rows
data_manifest.purpose: Exact 2K training prefix for checks; not a separate training run

checkpoint_transport.method: exit85 plus scheduler transfer; local save alone is not durable

config.optimizer: native MuonAdamW; connector AdamW at native unembedding LR, no decay
config.loss: full-token full-vocabulary CCE; no gradient filtering

compute_estimate.accounting: FMA=2 FLOPs; allowed attention pairs, not masked dense-kernel execution. Backward approximated as2x consumed forward matrix FLOPs. Excludes softmax/norm/activation/optimizer/recomputation and is not measured hardware FLOPs.
compute_estimate.statistics_note: FLA fused backend shares QK/softmax; one extra P@phi(V) for variance or SiLU Jensen. Excludes nonlinear pointwise work and FlashAttention backward probability recomputation.
compute_estimate.innovation_note: When enabled: forward counts inference only; training adds two predictor forwards plus dH for NTP and dW for local MSE; no other predictor gradients.
compute_estimate.memory_note: Actual training peak VRAM must be measured separately.

innovation_objective.predictor: dense affine per attention/MLP branch; raw h input
innovation_objective.local_loss: sum of per-branch mean MSE(P(stopgrad(h)), stopgrad(r)); no backbone gradients
innovation_objective.ntp: predictor parameters detached; hidden Jacobian includes -beta*W
innovation_objective.initialization: W=0.001 I, b=0; full rank initially, unconstrained thereafter
innovation_objective.optimizer: local-only AdamW lr0.001 betas0.9/0.99 eps1e-8 WD0; same LR schedule
innovation_objective.r_squared: 1-SSE/SST; centered per channel over full fixed dev set; undefined at zero variance

quality_reference.note: Existing matched 10B Triton baseline. Gate 50-step CE is not a quality conclusion.
